title: scandosorbus intermedia
intro: Scandosorbus intermedia, commonly known as the Intermediate Rowan or Mountain Ash, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the mountainous regions of East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, offering health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Scandosorbus intermedia include its ability to act as an anti-hemorrhagic and anti-tumor agent, making it potentially useful in treating conditions such as bleeding disorders and certain types of cancer. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
